label: Abandoned stilt village
about: An abandoned Argonian stilt village of tiered timber halls.

label: Barsaebic Ayleid ruin
about: A ruin of the Barsaebic Ayleids, often with undead and Fenlord tombs below.

label: Belvedere
about: A lookout house or retreat built for its view.

label: Cave
about: A natural cave.

label: City
about: A city of the metropolis, large-city or small-city tier.

label: Estate
about: A plantation or landholder's estate worked by tenants or bonded labour.

label: Farm
about: A farm.

label: Ferry
about: A ferry landing across a river or channel.

label: Fort
about: A garrisoned fort.

label: Hamlet
about: A named handful of stilt houses or huts too small to be a village (a named triangle that is not a fort).

label: Homestead
about: A lone household on its own land.

label: Imperial ruin
about: A ruined Imperial (Second or Third Empire) tower, waystation or fort.

label: Keep
about: A stone keep, held or fallen.

label: Kothringi ruin
about: A stone ruin of the Kothringi, the silver-skinned humans dead of the Knahaten Flu.

label: Landmark
about: A named natural or built feature worth finding.

label: Lighthouse
about: A lighthouse and its keeper's house.

label: Lilmothiit ruin
about: A turf-and-leaf domed den of the Lilmothiit, the fox-folk of the southern coast.

label: Logging camp
about: A timber camp.

label: Mine
about: A mine: an entrance in the ground or a hillside and a worked interior.

label: Outlaw camp
about: A pirate or smuggler camp.

label: Outpost
about: A waystation, watch post or trading post.

label: Peak
about: A high point with a view.

label: Prison
about: A prison (Blackrose Prison).

label: Quarry
about: A stone quarry.

label: Shipwreck
about: A wreck, on a shore or under the water.

label: Station
about: A working platform at sea (Bell Station: a diving-bell station).

label: Sunken ruin
about: A drowned spire on the sea floor.

label: Town
about: A town.

label: Tribal camp
about: A seasonal or permanent camp of a named Argonian tribe.

label: Cantemiric Velothi ruin
about: A ruin of the Cantemiric Velothi, the Dunmer settlers of the eastern seaboard, dead of the Knahaten Flu.

label: Village
about: A village.
